Cada apartado te explica cómo funciona l: Each section explains how it works the first time you enter. If you forget something, press “How does it work?” next to the title and it shows up again.
Nexo revisa solo al abrir y, si hay una: Nexo checks on its own when it opens and, if there's a new version, lets you know with an “Update now” button. Your data is kept.
Los PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint y Bloc: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Notepad show their program's real logo, and so do Spotify and YouTube in search.
Después de cada actualización verás aquí: After each update you'll see here what changed. You can open it again from Settings › About.
«Nuevo archivo», las herramientas de Doc: “New file”, the Documents tools and your subjects' folders use the real logos of Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Notepad.
Pulsa Ctrl + K y escribe una palabra: Ne: Press Ctrl + K and type a word: Nexo finds it inside the PDFs in your subject folders and opens them right on that page.
En Mis tareas, dentro de una materia, cr: In My assignments, inside a subject, create a blank Word, Excel, PowerPoint or text file right there.
En Configuración › Apariencia › Idioma e: In Settings › Appearance › Language choose Español, English or “Same as Windows”. It changes everything: menus, guides, what's new, notices and even the system tray.
Nexo ahora se revisa solo con pruebas au: Nexo is now checked automatically with tests every time something changes, so updates arrive more stable.
